meta.commitMessage:
Living residents (directive s4): ResidentDirector + world-state persistence + EOS token caching + security scanner discriminators

- ResidentDirector: 4 holographic residents (Echo/Vector/Mira/Delta), deterministic
  seeded personalities, autonomous wander/idle, separation steering + JARVIS
  avoidance, real-time clock (session-2 lesson), reduced-motion accessibility freeze
- Persistence: NexusWorldState.residentsJson (schema + local db push + defensive
  runtime ALTER TABLE for the production volume); /api/v1/world/residents
  GET public / PATCH owner-key; client applies on every world snapshot and persists
  every 45s + pagehide keepalive; round-trip proven server->browser->server
- NaN-velocity bug (separationForce {x,z} vs .y wiring) caught by the new unit
  suite before ship; live-scene verification 5/5 (present/finite/moving/armor/zero
  errors); evidence screenshot
- eos.ts: EOS-SDK-style client-token caching (one exchange per ~hour, not per
  status request); honest cached-verdict reporting when a live refresh fails
  inside a valid window (external client_not_found regression documented)
- security scanners: structural discriminators (all-lowercase test names vs real
  mixed-case tokens; obvious test fixtures) — broad scan now passes alongside
  the deep audit 3/3 (1,448 git objects)
- docs: PROJECT_STATE/CHANGELOG/INTEGRATIONS session-8 records

Blender asset production system: 3 REAL .blend assets (validated+exported) + MCP protocol-tested 11/11 under real Blender 5.0.1 + CF model deprecation fix

- world/Blender/: full blueprint Part 6 structure + nexusblender automation library
  (procedural modelling, PBR materials, packed 512^2 T_* textures, UV, COL_ collision,
  real decimated LODs ~50%/~20%, metadata JSON, naming conventions)
- 3 real assets: SM_House (38,756 tris), SM_Shop (31,764), SM_Prop_StreetLamp (4,128)
  — all within blueprint budgets; validator exit 0 (validation/ValidationReport.json);
  GLB exports + meta sidecars; Cycles CPU evidence previews
- Real-Blender MCP protocol test 11/11 (scripts/test_blender_mcp.py): real TCP socket,
  main-thread bpy execution per the addon contract; caught+fixed 2 real addon bugs
  (args-dict dispatcher blow-up, empty wire floor disc)
- CF Workers AI default model updated: llama-3.1-8b-instruct DEPRECATED 2026-05-30
  (HTTP 410 — caught by the real production LLM test); llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast
  verified live (HTTP 200 + real completion against the owner's account)
- Security deep-audit: placeholder detector (20+ identical chars = template, not
  credential); 3/3 pass, 1448 git objects clean
- world/Unreal/Python/import_blender_assets.py: the Blender->Unreal import hop
  (authored; executes on the owner UE machine per blocker B2)

Merge origin/main (Phases 0-3, Gate 0 security, Groq provider) with parallel sessions 7-8 (EOS real-OAuth, avatar NaN armor superset, CF Workers AI + OpenAI providers)

- Both lines independently fixed the same avatar NaN black-void bug; unified on the production-proven fail-closed guard + computeInspectYaw + 4-layer armor
- registry.ts: union of all providers — cloudflare_workers_ai, groq_cloud, openai (opt-in), openai_compatible, zai_cloud_route; free-tier-first default chain
- unreal/ -> world/Unreal/ restructure adopted (their F-C1 disposition); salvaged AutoExposure renderer setting + MetaHumanPlugin + EOS example config into JarvisWorld
- eos.ts: current session-7 OAuth-verified detail text + world/Unreal consumer paths
- Docs: both narratives preserved (theirs primary, parallel line marked)
- Verification: 100/100 unit tests, tsc clean, production build clean, FastAPI CORE 43/43

Phase 3 (Unreal foundation) RESTORED after sandbox-recycle loss

The original Phase 3 work (merge af94759, tag phase-3-authored) was never
pushed (B6: .env.local wiped) and was lost with the recycled sandbox. This
commit re-authors it exactly per download/PHASE-3-REPORT.md's specification
and re-verifies it to the same evidence standard:

- world/Unreal/: JarvisWorld.uproject (UE 5.5), Config (WP hash 512 m,
  ProjectID 8806666E405E42C1836AD3DA511CFBB1, v0.3.0-phase3), targets +
  module (BuildSettingsVersion.V5), JarvisGeoLibrary (Krueger 6th-order TM,
  authoritative conversion), JarvisWorldIdentity (PREFIX-NNN), 4 automation
  tests, Python layer (jarvis_geo mirror, create_test_map, validate_project),
  Build scripts, README steps 1-9.
- F-C1 migration re-applied: git mv unreal/Plugins/JarvisNexusEOS and
  unreal/Python/jarvis_http_bridge.py into world/Unreal/; legacy .uproject +
  Config removed; unreal/README.md rewritten as tombstone; path references
  updated (eos.ts, unrealBridge.ts, INTEGRATIONS.md); .gitignore (EOS json
  path, package-lock.json, __pycache__).
- docs/blueprint/CHANGES.md Entry 002 re-recorded.

Evidence re-run this session: geo_verify ALL PASS (round-trip 0.000005 mm /
10,010 pts; PROJ cross-check 0.000003 mm / 2,000 pts); geo_verify_cpp ALL
PASS (g++ -O2 -Wall -Wextra, C++ vs PROJ 0.0005 mm); py_compile 4/4; JSON
2/2; real build attempt -> exit 1 'UE_ROOT is not set' (B2); npm test 80/80;
tsc 0 errors; next build SUCCESS; FastAPI CORE 43/43.

B6 unblocked: repo/.env.local restored (GITHUB_TOKEN from credentials.env).
